chunks: And Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام said:
Engage in trade, for in it there is independence for you from what is in the hands of the people.

key_terms.أَيْدِي: hands, meaning the possession or control of others
key_terms.النَّاسِ: people, i.e. other members of society

ai.seo_question: How does Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام describe the value of trade?
ai.summary: Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام encourages people to pursue trade as a means of lawful self-sufficiency. The saying highlights economic independence and avoiding reliance on what others possess.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3723 - The Commander of the Faithful (as) said:
"Engage in trade, for in it lies independence from what is in the hands of others."
